author: /root/v230_audit_gateway_tooling
problem: The hosted platform log prints JS/Python output but no group result or Go outcome; Go subprocess output is captured in the platform result artifact, leaving the observed failed run ambiguous without that artifact.
implementation: Wrap each existing runVitest/runPythonTests/runGoTests invocation in runCiGroup to print one fixed JSON started event and one completed event. Unexpected thrown execution errors emit a fixed threw event and propagate the same exception.
Completed summaries include allowlisted group/status, bounded numeric exitCode, selected file count, and observed case-status counts; missing case evidence is null, not zero or success.

Go summaries contain only the five fixed phase names with allowlisted status and bounded numeric exitCode. Only known static reasons or a known phase failure prefix are printed; unknown reason content is replaced with a platform-artifact pointer. Raw case identities, test paths, exception messages, stderr, detail and payload are never printed by this new summary.
The wrapper returns the exact original result object and does not retry, skip subsequent groups after a returned failed result, replace evidence, alter exit aggregation, or change reconcileCi.

validation.skip: Existing Unix-only root fixture traversal test is not runnable on Windows

testsCover: Exact original result identity and single invocation across failed/skipped/passed groups; start/end ordering and missing case evidence.
Same thrown exception escapes and only a fixed diagnostic is emitted, excluding its secret message.

Five fixed Go phase states and allowlisted reason reporting, untrusted reason redaction, ignored extra checks, payload/path/case-ID suppression, and each output line below 1500 bytes for oversized synthetic reasons/checks.
Existing coverage gates continue rejecting failed, stale, missing, duplicate and all-skipped case evidence.
limits: No full suite, real Go compiler execution, CI trigger/retry, browser, deployment or online action was performed.
These new diagnostics improve future run visibility; they do not establish the missing Go outcome of the already-failed candidate run.
The test-only platform skip is retained as exit code 3; this is not reported as an all-platform pass.
Independent review remains assigned to root.
